answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 33 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 33 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 620 bought sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the jetty here is verification, the echo of cost is what stops the farm, and the delta of the record keeps every claim checkable.
